WTWW Lebanon, TN FAQ

What frequency is WTWW Lebanon, TN on?
In the A-26 season WTWW Lebanon, TN is scheduled on 4 shortwave frequencies, including 5085, 5920, 9475, 9930 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 9475 kHz (4 pm – 8 pm Eastern). For Europe: 9475 kHz (9 pm – 1 am UTC+1).

Can I hear WTWW Lebanon, TN in the USA?
Yes. WTWW Lebanon, TN is beamed at North America this season on 5085, 5920, 9475, 9930 kHz; the best evening option for eastern North America is 9475 kHz (4 pm – 8 pm Eastern).

Does WTWW Lebanon, TN broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 5085 kHz at 01:00–03:00 UTC to North America; 5085 kHz at 03:00–03:30 UTC to North America; 5920 kHz at 01:30–06:00 UTC to North America; 9475 kHz at 20:00–24h UTC to North America; 9930 kHz at 13:00–01:30 UTC to North America.
